'''Thermal Bank''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|The Thermal Bank is a facility that converts Originium Ore or batteries into electrical power. It must be connected to the power grid to work.|The Thermal Bank received 3 revolutionary tech upgrades in the last decade.}}
==Usage==
The Thermal Bank is a facility that converts Originium Ore or batteries into electrical power. It must be connected to the power grid to work.
